datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field assessments and compiled Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) data across Guatemala for 2020. The spatial IPC classifications were aggregated into geographic datasets representing different scenarios and time periods, distributed as GeoJSON and KML formats for near-term food insecurity projections.
